tagline: Beachfront Haven & Coastal Tranquility in Candolim

address.landmark: Direct private access to Candolim Beach

timings.early_check_in_policy: Early check-in from 10:00 AM is subject to beach villa availability.
timings.late_check_out_policy: Late check-out up to 4:00 PM can be requested for INR 2,000 depending on resort occupancy.

rooms.name: Sea View Luxury Cottage
rooms.description: Charming Portuguese-inspired coastal cottage featuring an open-air rain shower, private sun deck with sea breezes, and handcrafted teak furniture.
amenities: Mini Bar with Goan Craft Beers & Juices

rooms.name: Azure Lagoon Suite
rooms.description: Ground-level suite with direct swim-up lagoon pool access, outdoor jacuzzi whirlpool, and sunlit cabana patio.

rooms.name: Presidential Beachfront Villa
rooms.description: Ultra-exclusive private beachfront villa featuring its own private plunge pool, outdoor BBQ pavilion, direct sand access, and personal butler.
amenities: Private Beach Dining Setup upon request
Complimentary Airport Chauffeur from Dabolim / Mopa (GOI/GOX)

dining.name: Breeze Ocean Grill & Shack
dining.cuisine: Fresh Goan Seafood, Charcoal Grilled Catch of the Day & Portuguese Tapas
dining.breakfast_timings: 7:00 AM – 11:00 AM at The Palms Verandah
dining.breakfast_inclusion: Complimentary daily tropical breakfast buffet for all Villa and Lagoon Suite guests. For Cottage guests on room-only, it is INR 750 + taxes.
dining.highlights: Dine with your toes in the sand under swaying palm trees while listening to acoustic fado music.

dining.name: The Palms Verandah
dining.cuisine: All-Day Global & Coastal Indian Comfort Food
dining.highlights: Al-fresco poolside terrace serving wood-fired flatbreads, fresh Goan curries, and tropical smoothie bowls.

menu.name: Fresh Tender Coconut Water with Mint
menu.description: Naturally chilled tender coconut opened fresh to order, served with fresh mint sprigs and lime wedge.

menu.name: Kokum Cooler with Spiced Sea Salt
menu.description: Traditional Goan wild kokum fruit infusion with roasted cumin, rock salt, and sparkling water.

menu.name: Artisan Goan Spiced Cappuccino
menu.description: Velvety espresso steamed with whole milk and a whisper of cinnamon and cardamom.

menu.name: Coastal Lemon Coriander Soup
menu.description: Clear vegetable broth accented with fresh lemon juice, crushed garlic, and finely minced organic coriander stems.

menu.name: Goan Yellow Moong Dal with Poee Bread
menu.description: Lightly tempered comforting yellow lentils with mustard seeds and curry leaves, served with warm Goan whole-wheat poee.

menu.name: Goan Mushroom Caldin with Steamed Rice
menu.description: Tender button mushrooms and bell peppers cooked in a fragrant mild coconut milk and turmeric Caldin curry.

menu.name: Grilled Halloumi & Roasted Vegetable Wrap
menu.description: Seared halloumi cheese with bell peppers, zucchini, and sun-dried tomato tapenade in a toasted tortilla.

menu.name: Tropical Acai & Mango Smoothie Bowl
menu.description: Chilled organic acai blended with Alphonso mango pulp, topped with chia seeds, toasted coconut flakes, and wild honey.

menu.name: Authentic Goan Bebinca with Coconut Cream
menu.description: Traditional seven-layered warm Goan pudding baked with coconut milk, egg yolk, and nutmeg, served with vanilla ice cream.

amenities.name: Lagoon Freeform Swimming Pool
amenities.details: Massive 80-meter freeform freshwater pool meandering through tropical gardens with sunken cocktail bar.

amenities.name: Ayurveda & Ocean Breeze Spa
amenities.details: Beachfront massage cabanas offering traditional Shirodhara, herbal poultice therapies, and reflexology.

amenities.name: Private Beach Boardwalk & Cabanas
amenities.details: Direct guarded access to pristine Candolim sand with private sun loungers, towel service, and beach attendants.

amenities.name: Beach Volleyball & Water Sports Desk
amenities.details: Complimentary paddleboards, beach volleyball court, and concierge booking for parasailing and dolphin cruises.

services.name: Extra Pillows
services.description: Cooling gel or soft microfiber pillows delivered to your cottage.

services.name: Extra Beach & Bath Towels
services.description: Set of large striped beach towels and fluffy bath towels.

services.name: Complimentary Water Bottles
services.description: Fresh glass-bottled drinking water replenished directly in your room.

services.name: Full Housekeeping Refresh
services.description: Full beach sand sweep, bed linen change, and bathroom replenish.

services.name: Private Airport Chauffeur (Mopa or Dabolim)
services.description: Comfortable Innova Crysta or SUV transfer to Goa International Airport.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation is permitted up to 48 hours prior to check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours forfeit one night deposit.
policies.pets: Pets are allowed in private Sea View Cottages upon request with an INR 2,500 sanitation fee.
policies.smoking: Rooms are non-smoking. Smoking is permitted on outdoor open sun decks and beach gardens.
policies.children: Kids under 6 stay free. Kids club and beach toys are provided complimentary.
policies.id_requirements: Valid government ID required at check-in for all adult guests.

faqs.question: What time is check-in?
faqs.answer: Check-in at Oleria Goa Resort & Spa is from 2:00 PM onwards, and check-out is at 11:00 AM.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have beach access?
faqs.answer: Yes! Oleria Goa Resort & Spa has direct private boardwalk access straight onto Candolim Beach, complete with complimentary loungers and towel service.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, we feature an 80-meter tropical freeform lagoon pool with a sunken cocktail bar and direct swim-up rooms, open daily from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: How far is the airport?
faqs.answer: We are located approximately 55 minutes from Goa International Airport Dabolim (GOI) and 45 minutes from Manohar International Airport Mopa (GOX). Private chauffeur transfers can be booked for INR 2,200.
